overview: AWS is a cloud provider: it offers servers and managed services on demand that scale easily, so teams build applications without owning hardware. The history and market-share slides are context only; the exam tests what the services do, not AWS business facts.

coreConcepts.definition: A company that rents compute, storage and managed services on demand over the internet.
Resources are provisioned when needed and released when not, paying only for use.
Ability to grow or shrink capacity easily as load changes.

mustRemember: AWS provides servers and services you use on demand and scale easily.
Use cases span enterprise IT, backup and storage, big data analytics, website hosting, mobile and social apps, and gaming.
mentalModels: Think of AWS as renting a data center by the minute instead of buying one.

examTraps.trap: Memorise AWS revenue and market-share figures
examTraps.correction: Business statistics are not tested; focus on what services do and when to use them.
